title: Heart Lock — single-video analysis first
summary: YTIntel is now structurally focused on the endgame heart: one winning video in, a locked 17-section report out, creator DNA applied, and reusable intelligence banked for the vault.
discord_changes: HEART LOCK: Analyse + Vault are the active product. Watchtower is deliberately hidden until the 17-section single-video core is excellent.
CREATOR DNA: first-run setup now asks niche, subniche, channel, audience, brand rules and key competitors so prescriptive output has user context.
RESEARCH CONSOLE: analysis now exposes real task/workstream status, the 17-section roadmap and an activity feed — without fake waiting or hidden chain-of-thought.
changes: Added a canonical ENDGAME_BRIEF.md so the product scope and exact 17-section Monday Brief order stop drifting.
Added a first-run Creator DNA profile with niche, subniche, user channel, audience, brand rules and key competitors.
Composed user channel and key-competitor context into the existing creator-tailoring context used by local remake synthesis.
Added a live research workstream console with source, structure, retention, replay/visual, audio, packaging/channel, blueprint and cross-check lanes.
Added a visible 17-section analysis roadmap driven by actual pipeline progress rather than an artificial ten-minute timer.
Added an activity feed that shows concise task/evidence outcomes instead of hidden model reasoning.
Added a source-backed why-it-popped mechanics hypothesis to the summary section.
Added an intelligence bank that stores completed winner packages, opening hooks and creator context for later vault comparison surfaces.
Hidden the Watchtower/Competitors surface from the active v0.35.0 navigation while preserving its underlying code for the next product slice.
Preserved the deduplicated transcript/WPM correction and the exact 17-section report contract from v0.34.2.
known_limitations: Full frame-by-frame video inspection is not yet available when the source engine does not provide actual frames/video.
Acoustic music/SFX analysis is not claimed when raw audio is unavailable.
Most Replayed is only treated as real when a public replay curve is actually exposed; otherwise hypotheses remain labelled hypotheses.
Zero-credit mode cannot guarantee frontier cloud-model reasoning. Sections 2, 3, 14 and 16 use genuine on-device model synthesis only when a ready local model exists.
Creator DNA is local-first in this release; account-backed profile persistence can be wired when the login/account layer is reintroduced.
why_it_matters: The product now has one explicit center of gravity: save creators from watching and manually dissecting a winning video, then turn the evidence into something useful for their own channel.
